The [[Tomb Nightmare]] is a nightmare-typed creature that can be found in the [[Catacombs]] in the [[Prophecies]]-Tutorial. It has to be killed during the quest [[The Necromancer's Novice]] to take Necromancer as either first or secondary discipline. It has the highest level of all non-boss creatures in the catacombs.

==Notes==
*It has about -65 armor against cold damage. Even at low level and without any investment in [[Death Magic]], [[Deathly Swarm]] is very effective, dealing at least 60 damage to it. 
*An extremely easy way to take out the Tomb Nightmare is to [[pull]] it into the trap with a ranged weapon (i.e. a [[Range|Flatbow]] or [[Range|Longbow]]).
*Unlike other level 4 foes, it has only 120 [[health]].
